learning_outcomes.text: The objective of the course is to deepen the preparation of the organic chemistry course with a particular vision for an engineering student. It aims to train technicians with skills capable of receiving and following innovation, adapting to scientific and technological evolution.

The objective of the course is to provide a general, broad, and characterizing preparation in organic chemistry to an engineering student. It aims to train technicians with skills capable of receiving and following innovation, adapting to scientific and technological evolution.
the ability to apply acquired knowledge including transversal activities (ability to analyze, synthesize and form independent judgments, communicate)
mastery of methodological and operational aspects
the ability to have a general vision and correlate the various topics

syllabus_topics: Seminars and research on organic chemistry processes with particular industrial relevance.
Introduction to organic chemistry with brief recalls from general chemistry.
Acids and bases: strength, structural effects, Brønsted acids and bases, Lewis acids and bases.
assessment_rules: The exam is oral and aims to evaluate general comprehension and learning, critical ability to connect various topics, and the ability to evaluate the reactivity of a molecule or its preparation. Grading ranges from insufficient (fragmented knowledge, poor exposition) to excellent (mastery of material, strong synthesis and connection skills, excellent language and critical judgment). The exam for "COMPLEMENTI DI CHIMICA ORGANICA" is unified with the organic chemistry course.
